name: Black Widow: Espionage
description: Natasha Romanoff's past in the Red Room comes back to haunt her as the Taskmaster orchestrates a conspiracy targeting current and former Black Widow operatives. Trust is a liability, and every ally could be a weapon turned against you.
flavorText: In espionage, the truth is the most dangerous weapon of all.
musicAIPrompt: Create a 45-second seamless loopable orchestral film score in the exact style of John Williams. Suspense / Tension Build. Red Room conspiracy and spy betrayal. Ticking woodwinds, sultry low strings, sudden sharp string stabs. Tense and cinematic, wide stereo, instrumental only, perfectly loopable with no fade in/out.
